name: Tangoe Technology Expense Analytics
description: Tangoe One technology expense management analytics: one row per billed service line (mobile line, SaaS seat, UCaaS seat, circuit or cloud account) per vendor invoice, with recurring, usage, roaming and tax charges, data and voice usage, zero-usage (zombie) lines and wasted spend, invoice audit billing errors, disputes and credits recovered, by business unit, cost center, GL code, vendor, country and device. Synthetic. Monthly invoices, Nov 2024 to Nov 2026.

columns.name: Charge ID
columns.desc: Unique invoice charge line (one service line on one carrier or vendor invoice).

columns.name: Invoice Date
columns.desc: Date of the carrier, SaaS or cloud invoice the charge appears on.

columns.name: Assigned User
columns.desc: Employee the line, device or license is assigned to.

columns.name: Region
columns.desc: Global region of the service.

columns.name: Country
columns.desc: Country where the service is billed.

columns.name: Business Unit
columns.desc: Business unit that owns the line or license.

columns.name: Service Category
columns.desc: Mobile, SaaS, UCaaS, Wireline Voice, Data Network, Internet or IaaS.

columns.name: Vendor
columns.desc: Carrier, SaaS publisher or cloud provider that billed the charge.

columns.name: Device Model
columns.desc: Device on the mobile line (Not a device for non-mobile services).

columns.name: Rate Plan
columns.desc: Rate plan, license SKU or circuit product billed.

columns.name: Cost Center
columns.desc: Cost center the charge is allocated to.

columns.name: GL Code
columns.desc: General-ledger account the charge posts to.

columns.name: Service ID
columns.desc: Line, license seat, circuit or cloud account identifier.

columns.name: Invoice Number
columns.desc: Vendor invoice the charge appears on.

columns.name: Error Type
columns.desc: Billing error found by invoice audit (No Error when the charge is clean).

columns.name: Audit Status
columns.desc: Clean, Dispute Open, Credited or Rejected.

columns.name: Line Status
columns.desc: Active or Suspended.

columns.name: Recommended Action
columns.desc: Optimization action Tangoe recommends for the line or license.

columns.name: Zero-Usage Lines
columns.desc: Lines or licenses billed with no data, voice or login for 30+ days.

columns.name: Billed Lines
columns.desc: Count of billed service lines, seats, circuits and accounts.

columns.name: Data Usage GB
columns.desc: Data used in the billing period, GB.

columns.name: Voice Minutes
columns.desc: Voice minutes used in the billing period.

columns.name: Recurring Charges
columns.desc: Monthly recurring charges (plan, seat or circuit fee).

columns.name: Usage Charges
columns.desc: Overage and usage-based charges.

columns.name: Roaming Charges
columns.desc: International roaming charges.

columns.name: Taxes and Fees
columns.desc: Taxes, surcharges and regulatory fees.

columns.name: Billed Amount
columns.desc: Total invoiced amount for the charge line.

columns.name: Wasted Spend
columns.desc: Amount billed for zero-usage lines and unused licenses.

columns.name: Days Since Last Use
columns.desc: Days since the line or license last had usage.

columns.name: Billing Errors
columns.desc: Charge lines with a billing error found by invoice audit.

columns.name: Disputed Amount
columns.desc: Amount disputed with the vendor after audit.

columns.name: Credits Recovered
columns.desc: Credits and refunds recovered from vendors.

columns.name: Dispute Age Days
columns.desc: Days an open dispute has been waiting for the vendor.

formulas.name: Zero-Usage Rate
formulas.desc: Share of billed lines and licenses with zero usage.

formulas.name: Billing Error Rate
formulas.desc: Share of charge lines with a billing error.

formulas.name: Recovery Rate
formulas.desc: Credits recovered as a share of disputed amount.

formulas.name: Wasted Spend Share
formulas.desc: Wasted spend as a share of billed spend.

formulas.name: Cost per Line
formulas.desc: Average billed amount per line per invoice.

formulas.name: Active Services
formulas.desc: Distinct lines, seats, circuits and accounts billed.
